import re

def parse_pair(content, pairno):
    inpsec=content.split(f'Demo pair {pairno} input (23x23):\n',1)[1].split(f'Demo pair {pairno} output (23x23):\n',1)
    inptext,outtext=inpsec[0],inpsec[1].split('\n\nSame instance.',1)[0]
    def rows(s): return [list(map(int,ln.split())) for ln in s.strip().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    return rows(inptext), rows(outtext)
def general_transform(grid):
    n=max(max(row) for row in grid)
    start=grid[0][1]
    seq=[((start-1+i)%n)+1 for i in range(n)]
    return [[seq[(c-(c>=r))%n] for c in range(len(grid[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
for idx,pn in [(10,1),(14,2)]:
    text=records[idx]['message']['content'][0]['text']
    inp,expected=parse_pair(text,pn)
    pred=general_transform(inp)
    print(pn, len(inp), len(expected), pred==expected, [(r,c,pred[r][c],expected[r][c]) for r in range(23) for c in range(23) if pred[r][c]!=expected[r][c]][:5])
